nom: Pure Retinol Face Serum with Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) & Hyaluronic Acid

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including several trying retinol for the first time, report no irritation, redness or dryness and describe the formula as noticeably gentler than other retinol products they have used; one reviewer's skin burned badly in the third week of use, and one felt a brief sting on first application that she attributes to her own application technique.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report good results: one had an initial, dramatic surge of oiliness in the first few days that normalized within about a week, after which her skin became smoother and blemish-free, while another with combo/dry skin found it worked well once she reduced how often she applied it to avoid flaking.
segments.dry: The one reviewer with combo/dry skin found the serum worked well once she reduced how often she applied it to avoid initial flaking, after which fine lines and freckles began to fade.

concerns.aging: This is the most widely reported benefit: many reviewers describe visibly softened fine lines and wrinkles, improved texture and a plumper, brighter look after several weeks to months of consistent use, including reviewers in their 30s, 40s and 60s; one reviewer used it for weeks without noticing any visible change.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the serum absorbs well and leaves skin soft and hydrated rather than dry, thanks to the niacinamide and hyaluronic acid, though a couple needed to reduce how often they applied it after their skin started flaking, and one notes the product itself is not very moisturizing and should be paired with a separate moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including some with sensitive skin who say other retinol products have burned them before, report no redness or burning with this serum; against this, one reviewer's skin burned badly enough in the third week to require burn-treatment cream, and another felt occasional irritation without visible redness.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report dark spots, sunspots or freckles visibly fading and their overall skin tone becoming more even after roughly two weeks to six months of consistent, careful use; one dissenting reviewer saw no change in her dark, problematic areas after two to three weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report existing breakouts clearing up and pores looking smaller or unclogged, in one case after an initial 'shock' of a few pimples and sensitivity that settled after about two weeks; another reviewer, who saw no improvement in her dark spots, does note the serum did not cause any new breakouts for her.
concerns.oiliness: The one detailed account of oiliness describes a dramatic surge, oily enough to stain a pillow, during the first few days of use, which settled back to normal oil levels within about a week and was followed by clearer, less oily-looking skin.

aspects.libelle: Packaging often arrives opened, unsealed or damaged
A few doubt the product's authenticity via this listing
Light, pleasant floral scent that fades quickly
Absorbs quickly without a sticky or greasy residue
A little goes a long way, bottle lasts months

extraits.texte: Not sure why, but the 3rd week of using it, it burned my skin! And it hurts! I was not using it every night, maybe every other night. This is what it did to me. Yes, it feels smooth when you put it on and it smells good, but the fact that it oxidizes yellow should have raised a red flag that will burn my skin. I didn’t see it coming! I can’t put anything on right now besides a cream for burn victims ( I work in the hospital and have some left). If you buy this, be very careful!

I've been using this for about 2-3 weeks now and I'm not noticing much of a change. I have used this on my entire face but I also focus on dark problematic areas and they are still pretty dark. I like that this doesn't make my face breakout. It also gives your face a tingly sensation when you apply it. I'm going to try to use this a little longer and see if it helps the spots pictured. If I see any improvement I'll update this. It just doesn't seem to be doing anything to my face so far.

extraits.titre: Yes, this really is as good as they say.
extraits.texte: Took a sample to try out from a friend, was totally sold, got a bottle myself. I have fair, combination skin and live in a hot climate, so I use it all year long except for the four hottest months when the sun is the most active. Yes, even with SPF50 I could feel my face starting to burn while I was using this product, so I replaced it with a niacinamide serum for the symmer. So, what magic did it do? Well, the first few days it was horrid. I applied it onto clean skin, topped with light moisturizer, and went to bed. To say that my face got oily is to say nothing. It was practically a pancake. I had oil stains on my pillow for the first time in my life. Thankfully, I read about retinol and the way it works, so I kept using it and waiting to see what happens. After a few days, oil levels were back to normal. After 2 weeks I woke up to photoshopped skin. No, seriously. It’s never looked so good in my entire life. Smooth, blemish-free, unclogged pores, black dots almost completely gone. I wish I took before and after pictures. I had zero adverse reactions, my skin has no issues with retinol, which is great. Wish I could keep using it through the summer, but it’s just not worth the risk. So if you’re doubting whether this serum is worth the $$$ - yes, every single penny. I’ve had $100+ products that did nothing while this little gem just fixed my skin. I thought I’d just never be rid of those blemishes and bumps. Power to LRP&retinol!

extraits.titre: Good Formula for Those Who Haven’t Tried/Used Retinol in a While
extraits.texte: The Le Roche-Posay Retinol Face Serum is a good serum to use if you’re looking to smooth out your skin and remove fine wrinkles. I haven’t used Retinol in a few months now and after trying this for the first time, realized I needed to use less product to start off as I started quickly flaking in the days following. After easing off the serum, I used less under my daily moisturizer/sunscreen and have been pleased with the results. My skin has been looking healthier, smoother, and the wrinkles and freckles are slowly starting to fade away. This is a product that does take time and dedication as well as very liberal amounts of sunscreen applied. The serum is slightly liquidy and easy to applie. The dropper allows for precise control on how much you apply to your face and I’ve found that it worked well with my combo/dry skin. This formula has a lightly floral scent to it that quickly fades as it dries. Overall, if you’re looking for a lower concentration retinol to start off with, this is a good option to consider.

extraits.titre: Made such a difference for me!
extraits.texte: I gave this 5 stars because it is my favorite serum I have used, not because it is some magical fix all! I am 34 stay at home mom of 3 young kids and I don't often have the time or desire to put on a lot of makeup. I haven't always felt comfortable going out without makeup; however, I have been working on my skincare regimen and I have to say this had really made a noticeable difference! 1. I have sensitive skin and other serums have burned in the past. I have had no redness or burning sensations! 2. While this is not the most moisturizing, it does say specifically to use this alongside a mositurizer. I have found a great light moisturizer to use after this and the 2 products are the extent of my face care anymore!! 3. A little goes a long way. It isn't sticky and soaks in quickly so I don't feel like I'm wiping off/wasting any 4. The price for this is reasonable as some serums get so $$$!! I have used drug store to $150/bottle serums and this is my favorite. I now feel so great going out without makeup!!

extraits.titre: “Faded My Dark Spots and Evened Out My Skin Tone – Excellent Retinol!”
extraits.texte: I’ve been using La Roche-Posay Retinol B3 for almost six months, and it has truly made a difference in my skin. The dark spots I had have noticeably faded, and my overall skin tone looks more even and radiant. What I really like is that even though I only use it once or twice a week at night, the results are still visible with consistency and care. This is an excellent product because it not only helps reduce pigmentation but also improves the texture of the skin, making it feel smoother and healthier. A very important tip: I never mix it with other active ingredients—only with my moisturizer after applying it. Used this way, it works effectively without irritation. Highly recommended for anyone looking to lighten dark spots and achieve a more uniform complexion!

I LOVE this brand! I first got the Blue Hyloronic Acid from La Roche, and I really loved it. I wanted to try the Retinol next because I used to be on a prescribed Retin-A cream for my acne. Now since I am 30, I have wanted to really make sure I am taking the best care of my skin. Both of these products have worked WONDERS. My skin has a much more smooth texture and evened out so well, it’s hydrated and I have a glow. All my tiny breakouts have cleared up which I usually always have one pimple at all times. Not anymore 🙏 My skin did have a little bit of a shock when I first started using La Roche’s Retinol serum but it wasn’t bad at all. Just a couple of pimples and some skin sensitivity but it regulated after 2 weeks. Make sure you wear your sunscreen and you’ll be good to go! Definitely give it a try, I will continue buying over and over again. The Amazon price is also about 10 dollars less than buying at Target too! FYI I have also been using their Toleriane moisturizer for daytime use and also their Toleriane night moisturizer. I love this brand so much I practically bought everything!
